DepartmentAuditorperformAudit Operation

After the auditor logs in, they can view the list of pending documents on their dashboard.

Single or batch audits can be performed.

Click the link to enter the document details page to view document content.

Audit comments must be entered for document audit.

You can browse the document content image before auditing.
